subject: Mid-contract expansion: staged packaging scenarios, discount cadence, and legal timeline
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@clearpath.ai>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: ClearPath expansion — initial SOW + ask on staged pricing

Hi team,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our execs like the performance numbers but want to confirm a practical expansion path before committing spend mid-contract. Attaching the SOW draft (clearpath_sow_v3.pdf) and a high-level usage forecast.

Key asks from our side:
- Can we get two packaging scenarios (conservative ramp vs. aggressive ramp) with staged discount milestones tied to usage thresholds?
- Is co-terming the expanded units with our existing contract possible, or do we need a standalone amendment?
- What procurement timeline and contract handoffs do you recommend so we can close by mid-December?

Ideally we’d like the commercial outline this week so Legal can start parallel review.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Reynolds
Head of Platform
ClearPath AI
(attachment: clearpath_sow_v3.pdf)

From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@clearpath.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ClearPath expansion — initial SOW + ask on staged pricing

Tom — thanks for the clear brief and the forecast. Attached is a first-pass workbook (packaging_scenarios_q4.xlsx) with three commercial scenarios and the suggested discount cadence. High level:

Scenario A — Conservative ramp - Add 20% reserved capacity now, convert over next 3 months; 5% discount at 50% of forecasted usage, additional 5% at 90%

Scenario B — Measured scale (recommended) - Add 50% reserved capacity now, 7.5% uplift discount at 60% usage, 7.5% more at 100% usage; includes short-term burst pool for six months

Scenario C — Aggressive (volume-first) - Add 100% with a stepped discount starting at 10% and rising to 18% at sustained 120% of forecasted usage

Two things to call out:
1) Co-terming: we can add the capacity as an amendment and co-term to your existing renewal date. That keeps a single annual renewal cadence and is our usual path for mid-contract growth.
2) Legal & procurement timeline: if you sign the amendment before 2026-12-15 we can bring the change live in our capacity plan for Jan start; legal redlines typically take 3–5 business days if they’re limited to commercial terms.

Next steps I propose:
- You review the workbook and mark preferred scenario (A/B/C)
- I’ll circulate a short amendment draft for Legal to tempo-in alongside your redlines
- Tentative Go-live window: 2027-01-03 to 2027-01-10 depending on capacity provisioning

I’ve put Ben on copy to confirm the burst pool and provisioning lead times.

Best,
Olga Petrova
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
(attachment: packaging_scenarios_q4.xlsx)

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ClearPath expansion — initial SOW + ask on staged pricing

Quick internal check:
- Scenario B looks like the best balance; agree on a 7.5% step, but recommend we cap the burst pool at 20% of added capacity to avoid over-provisioning.
- Provisioning note: for Jan 3 target we need a signed amendment by 2026-12-13 latest to trigger standard GPU pool scheduling.

I’ll validate exact SLAs for the burst buffer and confirm in the amendment language.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Solutions Architecture | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

On a side note — pricing: if ClearPath opts for the aggressive path (C) we should table an additional multi-quarter performance review tied to unit economics to avoid quality regressions with quantized inference.

From: Legal Ops <contracts@clearpath.ai>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: ClearPath — redlines on SOW and amendment (inline)

Forwarding our redlines and a couple of comments. Please see the attached (redlines_clearpath_v3.docx). Main concerns:
- Need clearer data residency language for EU subset of their users (they’re US-first but some processing may touch EU customers)
- Termination for convenience: want a 30-day window for the added capacity with pro-rated refunds if usage is below threshold during first 60 days
- Approval workflow: they require a single PO + countersign via DocuSign (they do not accept e-sign by email)

Tom is on copy — we’d like a quick call to walk legal through the amendment before we push countersign.

— Legal Ops
contracts@clearpath.ai
(attachment: redlines_clearpath_v3.docx)

From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@clearpath.ai>, Legal Ops <contracts@clearpath.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: ClearPath — redlines on SOW and amendment (inline)

Tom / Legal team — thanks for the quick review and the redlines. Short answers and proposed path: 

1) Data residency: we’ll add explicit EU processing carve-outs and an option to route EU traffic to a regional endpoint. I’ll draft language and flag it for our Privacy team; that should be a narrow addendum, not a blocker.

2) Termination / pro-rate: we can offer a 30-day early-exit pro-rate for the additional capacity with a usage floor set at 40% of the forecasted ramp for the first 60 days. If usage < floor we’ll refund the overage pro-rated for the remainder of the month. That’s our suggested compromise to protect both sides.

3) PO + countersign: understood. We’ll prepare the amendment and push a DocuSign envelope. Proposed timeline:
- 2026-12-03: I’ll share a redline-ready amendment (commercial + data residency clause)
- 2026-12-06: 30-minute legal-to-legal call to walk redlines (suggested attendees: Olga, Ben, ClearPath Legal Ops)
- 2026-12-09: DocuSign envelope sent once your PO is received
- 2027-01-03: Target provisioned capacity (pending countersign and PO)

If that works I’ll schedule the 12/06 slot and circulate the amendment draft tomorrow.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this quickly.

Olga Petrova
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
